name: Spotify
summary: Control Spotify playback, search music, and manage playlists

tools.name: spotify_now_playing
tools.description: Get the currently playing item on Spotify, including playback details.

tools.name: spotify_play
tools.description: Start or resume Spotify playback. Optionally provide a Spotify URI (track, album, artist, or playlist) to play something specific.

uri.description: Spotify URI to play (e.g. spotify:track:..., spotify:album:..., spotify:playlist:...). Omit to resume current playback.

device_id.description: Target device ID (from spotify_get_devices). Omit to use the active device.
Target device ID. Omit to use the active device.

tools.name: spotify_next
tools.description: Skip to the next track in the Spotify queue.

device_id.description: Target device ID. Omit to use the active device.

tools.name: spotify_previous
tools.description: Go back to the previous track on Spotify.

device_id.description: Target device ID. Omit to use the active device.

tools.name: spotify_search
tools.description: Search Spotify for tracks, albums, artists, or playlists. Returns names, URIs, and metadata for use with other Spotify tools.

query.description: Search query (e.g. 'Daft Punk Digital Love', 'chill jazz playlist').

type.description: Type of result to search for (default: track).

limit.description: Max number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50).

tools.name: spotify_add_to_playlist
tools.description: Add a track to a Spotify playlist by playlist ID and track URI.

track_uri.description: Spotify track URI to add (e.g. spotify:track:...).

tools.name: spotify_get_playlists
tools.description: List the current user's Spotify playlists with IDs and track counts.

limit.description: Max number of playlists to return (default: 20, max: 50).

tools.name: spotify_get_devices
tools.description: List available Spotify Connect devices (speakers, phones, computers) with their IDs and active status.
